series.title: The Parking Spot
series.cast: Vertical 9:16 stylized 3D animated comedy with lively camera moves and lots of motion; talking cars with expressive semi-human faces: big eyes in the windshield and a mouth in the front grille that visibly moves in sync whenever that car speaks; the cars face, bump and react to each other. English dialogue spoken by the cars themselves, no narrator, no on-screen text or subtitles, no brand logos. Original designs, not any existing film characters. Characters: GOLDIE, an old boxy two-tone cream-and-mint station wagon with wood side panels and round headlights like reading glasses, calm wise voice; VIPER, a low wedge-shaped matte-purple electric hypercar with neon green stripes and slit LED eyes, cocky young voice; TOBY, a tall bright-blue tow truck with a crane arm, square friendly eyes and a red bandana, slow sleepy voice.

🚗 Two cars, one parking spot. Follow for Part 2!

beats.speaker: VIPER
beats.caption_en: Move it, grandpa. That spot is reserved for luxury.

beats.scene: Goldie peers over his headlight-glasses, unimpressed: "Reserved? I've parked here for twenty years, sonny."
beats.speaker: GOLDIE
beats.caption_en: Reserved? I've parked here for twenty years, sonny.

beats.scene: Viper revs loudly, bouncing on his wheels and smirking: "Twenty years of rust, maybe."
beats.speaker: VIPER
beats.caption_en: Twenty years of rust, maybe.

beats.scene: Goldie chuckles and taps his wood panel proudly: "Rust is just experience you can see."
beats.speaker: GOLDIE
beats.caption_en: Rust is just experience you can see.

beats.scene: Viper swings sideways and squeezes into the space, laughing: "Too slow, old man!"
beats.speaker: VIPER
beats.caption_en: Too slow, old man!

beats.scene: Goldie calmly nods toward a red painted curb behind Viper: "Oh, Viper... you're parked in the fire lane."
beats.speaker: GOLDIE
beats.caption_en: Oh, Viper… you're parked in the fire lane.

beats.scene: Viper's eyes go wide as he looks down at the red curb: "The what?"
beats.speaker: VIPER
beats.caption_en: The what?

beats.scene: Toby the blue tow truck rolls in and hooks Viper's bumper with his crane while Viper yells: "This is not over!" Goldie smiles and parks.
beats.speaker: VIPER
beats.caption_en: This is not over!

beats.scene: Goldie raises his headlight-glasses, thinks, then grins: "A race? At my age? ...You're on."

beats.scene: On an empty street at a chalk start line, Toby waves a checkered flag with his crane arm: "Engines ready... set..."

beats.scene: Goldie and Viper rev side by side; Goldie winks: "Hope you like the view of my bumper, kid."

series.title: Halo of Coins
series.cast: Vertical 9:16 stylized 3D animated comedy-drama, glossy cinematic lighting, lively camera, expressive semi-human fruit and vegetable heads on human bodies; every character's mouth visibly moves in sync when they speak and they react to each other. English dialogue spoken by the characters themselves, no narrator, no on-screen text or subtitles, no logos. Wealth is shown as small glowing gold coins slowly orbiting each character's head -- the more coins, the richer. Original designs only. Characters: SAM, a sun-gold mango-headed man in a faded denim jacket and a grey knitted beanie, ONE lonely copper coin circling his head, calm warm voice; BOLT, his old butler, a silver-grey artichoke head with a velvet bow tie and white gloves, dry deadpan voice; LINA, a lime-headed young woman with a freckled rind, yellow raincoat, a modest ring of coins, quick kind voice; MR. FIGGS, her father, a purple fig head with a monocle and a thick golden ring of coins, booming pompous voice; MRS. FIGGS, a plum head with a pearl headband who polishes her coins with a hanky, sing-song snobbish voice; DOLLY, Lina's sister, a pink dragonfruit head with sunglasses indoors, bored drawl; TREVOR, Dolly's husband, a coconut head with slicked hair and a huge coin halo whose coins are secretly painted cardboard, braggy voice; GRANDPA OKRA, a tall wrinkled okra patriarch with half-moon glasses and a slow drifting galaxy of coins, soft gravel voice.

parts.caption:
Halo of Coins — Part 1
🪙 Everyone's wealth floats over their head. He wears one coin on purpose. Follow for Part 2!

Made with AI

beats.scene: A sleek private train cabin at night; Bolt pours tea and stares at Sam's single copper coin: "Sir, you have ten thousand coins. And you're wearing ONE?"
beats.speaker: BOLT
beats.caption_en: Sir, you have ten thousand coins. And you're wearing ONE?

beats.scene: Sam tugs his grey beanie lower over his head, smiling, and says to Bolt: "I want to know who's kind to me when they can't see the rest."
beats.speaker: SAM
beats.caption_en: I want to know who's kind to me when they can't see the rest.

beats.scene: Bolt raises one eyebrow and sets the teapot down with a clink: "With one coin, sir, people will treat you like a vending machine."
beats.speaker: BOLT
beats.caption_en: With one coin, sir, people will treat you like a vending machine.

beats.scene: Sam winks and taps the beanie: "Exactly what I'm paying to find out."
beats.speaker: SAM
beats.caption_en: Exactly what I'm paying to find out.

beats.scene: A rainy city street; Lina in her yellow raincoat hurries up to Sam under a bus shelter, breathless: "You! One-coin guy! Be my boyfriend for one dinner tonight?"
beats.speaker: LINA
beats.caption_en: You! One-coin guy! Be my boyfriend for one dinner tonight?

beats.scene: Sam blinks at her, then glances at his lonely orbiting coin: "You picked me because I look poor, didn't you?"
beats.speaker: SAM
beats.caption_en: You picked me because I look poor, didn't you?

beats.scene: Lina nods honestly, rain dripping off her hood: "My family judges people by their halo. I want to watch them meet a good one-coin man."
beats.speaker: LINA
beats.caption_en: My family judges people by their halo. I want to watch them meet a good one-coin man.

beats.scene: Sam laughs, shakes her hand; she walks off and turns back mid-rain: "Dinner's at six. Wear something... cheaper."
beats.speaker: LINA
beats.caption_en: Dinner's at six. Wear something... cheaper.

parts.caption:
Halo of Coins — Part 2
🪙 He brought a gift. They brought a tape measure. Follow for Part 3!

Made with AI

beats.scene: Outside a gaudy mansion at dusk; Bolt hands Sam a small glass box holding one glowing golden mango: "The first fruit of your first tree, sir. There is no second one."
beats.speaker: BOLT
beats.caption_en: The first fruit of your first tree, sir. There is no second one.

beats.scene: Mr. Figgs opens the grand door, squints at Sam's single coin and pulls out a tape measure: "Lina. Your boyfriend's halo is shorter than my doormat."
beats.speaker: MR. FIGGS
beats.caption_en: Lina. Your boyfriend's halo is shorter than my doormat.

beats.scene: Lina steps between them, chin up: "His name is Sam, Dad. Try measuring his manners."
beats.speaker: LINA
beats.caption_en: His name is Sam, Dad. Try measuring his manners.

beats.scene: Mrs. Figgs polishes one of her orbiting coins with a hanky and sniffs at Sam's jacket: "Denim. At dinner. How brave."
beats.speaker: MRS. FIGGS
beats.caption_en: Denim. At dinner. How brave.

beats.scene: At a long candlelit table, Trevor leans back and makes his giant coin halo spin faster: "Two thousand coins, buddy. They follow me into the shower."
beats.speaker: TREVOR
beats.caption_en: Two thousand coins, buddy. They follow me into the shower.

beats.scene: Sam calmly sips water and eyes one of Trevor's coins, which is peeling at the edge: "One of them is peeling, buddy."
beats.speaker: SAM
beats.caption_en: One of them is peeling, buddy.

beats.scene: Dolly lowers her sunglasses, bored, and points at Sam's lonely coin: "Is that a coin or a lost button?"
beats.speaker: DOLLY
beats.caption_en: Is that a coin or a lost button?

beats.scene: Sam slides the glass box with the glowing mango toward Mr. Figgs with a polite smile: "A gift. Please be careful with it."
beats.speaker: SAM
beats.caption_en: A gift. Please be careful with it.

parts.caption:
Halo of Coins — Part 3
🪙 They broke the one thing money can't buy twice. Follow for the finale!

Made with AI

beats.scene: Mr. Figgs holds the glass box up to the candlelight, sneering at the glowing mango: "A mango? We ARE fruit, young man. This is practically cannibalism."
beats.speaker: MR. FIGGS
beats.caption_en: A mango? We ARE fruit, young man. This is practically cannibalism.

beats.scene: Trevor snatches the box, shaking it like a snow globe while everyone gasps: "It's glowing. Cheap battery inside, I bet."
beats.speaker: TREVOR
beats.caption_en: It's glowing. Cheap battery inside, I bet.

beats.scene: Lina jumps up, reaching for it, panicked: "Trevor, put it down! Now!"
beats.speaker: LINA
beats.caption_en: Trevor, put it down! Now!

beats.scene: The box slips from Trevor's hands and shatters on the marble; the golden mango rolls across the floor: "Oops. Relax, I'll buy you a whole bag."
beats.speaker: TREVOR
beats.caption_en: Oops. Relax, I'll buy you a whole bag.

beats.scene: Mr. Figgs steps on the rolling mango with a squish and points at the door: "There. Now get your one coin out of my house."
beats.speaker: MR. FIGGS
beats.caption_en: There. Now get your one coin out of my house.

beats.scene: Sam stands slowly, not angry, just quiet, and looks at the family one by one: "When you find out what you just stepped on, you'll wish you'd said hello."
beats.speaker: SAM
beats.caption_en: When you find out what you just stepped on, you'll wish you'd said hello.

beats.scene: Grandpa Okra shuffles over, kneels, and lifts the golden seed; a tiny crown is carved into it: "The crown seed... from the very first grove."
beats.speaker: GRANDPA OKRA
beats.caption_en: The crown seed... from the very first grove.

beats.scene: Grandpa Okra looks up at Sam, his coin galaxy trembling, voice shaking: "Young man... who ARE you?"
beats.speaker: GRANDPA OKRA
beats.caption_en: Young man... who ARE you?

parts.caption:
Halo of Coins — Part 4 (final)
🪙 He took off the beanie. Their coins started sweating. The end!

Made with AI

beats.scene: Sam pulls off his beanie; ten thousand glowing coins burst out and fill the whole dining room like a golden storm: "I'm the one who planted the grove, sir."
beats.speaker: SAM
beats.caption_en: I'm the one who planted the grove, sir.

beats.scene: Mr. Figgs drops his monocle into his soup, and his own coins suddenly look tiny: "Sam! Son! Have I mentioned how much I LOVE denim?"
beats.speaker: MR. FIGGS
beats.caption_en: Sam! Son! Have I mentioned how much I LOVE denim?

beats.scene: A draft from the storm of coins blows Trevor's halo apart; painted cardboard coins flutter to the floor: "Those were... on loan."
beats.speaker: TREVOR
beats.caption_en: Those were... on loan.

beats.scene: Mrs. Figgs frantically polishes Sam's chair with her hanky, grinning: "Would the gentleman like the good forks? We have good forks!"
beats.speaker: MRS. FIGGS
beats.caption_en: Would the gentleman like the good forks? We have good forks!

beats.scene: Sam gently turns to Lina, ignoring the scramble: "You were the only one who asked my name first."
beats.speaker: SAM
beats.caption_en: You were the only one who asked my name first.

beats.scene: Lina smiles and pokes his lonely copper coin, which is still circling bravely: "Good thing. I only ever counted one."
beats.speaker: LINA
beats.caption_en: Good thing. I only ever counted one.

beats.scene: Grandpa Okra hands Sam the crown seed back with a small bow: "Plant it again, son. Some of us still need to grow."
beats.speaker: GRANDPA OKRA
beats.caption_en: Plant it again, son. Some of us still need to grow.

beats.scene: Sam and Lina walk out into the night, the coin storm following them like fireflies; Bolt holds the door, deadpan: "Shall I tell them dessert is cancelled, sir?"
beats.speaker: BOLT
beats.caption_en: Shall I tell them dessert is cancelled, sir?

series.title: The Sand Contract
series.cast: Vertical 9:16 stylized 3D animated comedy-drama, warm golden-hour Mediterranean light on an Egyptian coast, lively camera with slow push-ins, crashing waves and spray; expressive semi-realistic cartoon humans with big eyes; every character's mouth visibly moves in sync when they speak and they react to each other. Egyptian Arabic dialogue spoken by the characters themselves, no narrator, no on-screen text or subtitles, no logos. Everyone's remaining life is a small glowing HOURGLASS floating above their head -- the sand level shows how much time they have left. Original designs only. Characters: ZAIN, a skinny young builder of 19 in dusty blue overalls and a tool belt, his hourglass almost empty, earnest hopeful voice; AM SAYED, an older builder of 60 with a bushy grey moustache and a fisherman's hat, a half-full hourglass, warm gruff voice; EL-BASHA, a rich boss in a white linen suit with a gold cane and an hourglass overflowing with gold sand, smug slow voice; ANTAR, his huge bodyguard in a red tracksuit and tiny sunglasses, a fierce hourglass, deep threatening voice that cracks when he is scared.

parts.caption:
عقد الرملة — الجزء ١
⏳ الوقت هنا فلوس. وزين فاضل له يوم واحد. تابع للجزء ٢!

Made with AI

beats.scene: On a golden beach, El-Basha taps Zain's almost-empty hourglass with his gold cane and it fills a little: "هديك عشر سنين. ابنيلي أجمد فندق في نص البحر."
beats.speaker: EL-BASHA
beats.caption_en: I'll give you ten years. Build me the grandest hotel in the middle of the sea.

beats.scene: Zain stares at the open sea, swallows hard, then nods bravely: "صعب... يمكن مستحيل. بس هعمل كل اللي أقدر عليه."
beats.speaker: ZAIN
beats.caption_en: It's hard... maybe impossible. But I'll do everything I can.

beats.scene: Antar leans down to El-Basha by a white convertible, whispering loudly: "يا باشا، الواد ده هيعملها بجد؟"
beats.speaker: ANTAR
beats.caption_en: Boss, is this kid really going to pull it off?

beats.scene: El-Basha adjusts his sunglasses and smirks: "لأ. هيقضي العشر سنين بياكل فول على الشط."
beats.speaker: EL-BASHA
beats.caption_en: No. He'll spend ten years eating fava beans on the beach.

beats.scene: Antar jabs a huge finger at Zain's hourglass, making the sand tremble: "لو بوّظتها، أنا بنفسي هقلب الساعة دي."
beats.speaker: ANTAR
beats.caption_en: Mess this up and I'll flip that hourglass myself.

beats.scene: Night on a rusty steel platform in the middle of the waves; Zain tightens a giant bolt alone, then calls out to Am Sayed rowing up in a small boat: "يا عم سيد، مش هقدر لوحدي. محتاجك."
beats.speaker: ZAIN
beats.caption_en: Am Sayed, I can't do this alone. I need you.

beats.scene: Am Sayed climbs onto the platform, looks at Zain's nearly empty hourglass, then at his own half-full one: "وإنت هتديني إيه؟ ما عندكش غير كام ساعة."
beats.speaker: AM SAYED
beats.caption_en: And what can you give me? You've only got a few hours.

beats.scene: Zain grins and holds out his hand; the storm starts rolling in behind them: "هقسم معاك الجايزة. ونخلي المستحيل ممكن."
beats.speaker: ZAIN
beats.caption_en: I'll split the reward with you. And we'll make the impossible possible.

parts.caption:
عقد الرملة — الجزء ٢
⏳ عشر سنين، عاصفة ورا عاصفة، والرملة بتخلص. تابع للجزء ٣!

Made with AI

beats.scene: A violent storm; huge waves slam the half-built steel tower; Am Sayed grabs Zain's arm as he climbs a swinging beam: "انزل يا مجنون! الموج هياخدك!"
beats.speaker: AM SAYED
beats.caption_en: Get down, you madman! The waves will take you!

beats.scene: Zain clings to the beam, spray in his face, and shouts back over the wind: "لأ! لازم أخلّص. الراجل صدّقني."
beats.speaker: ZAIN
beats.caption_en: No! I have to finish. The man believed in me.

beats.scene: Am Sayed looks at his own hourglass draining faster, then pours some of his glowing sand into Zain's: "خد من رملتي. إنت أصغر، وإنت اللي عندك حلم."
beats.speaker: AM SAYED
beats.caption_en: Take some of my sand. You're younger, and you're the one with the dream.

beats.scene: Zain's eyes fill with tears as his hourglass glows brighter: "يا عم سيد... ما ينفعش."
beats.speaker: ZAIN
beats.caption_en: Am Sayed... you can't.

beats.scene: Am Sayed laughs, wiping rain off his moustache: "ينفع ونص. أنا عشت كتير. يلا شد المسمار."
beats.speaker: AM SAYED
beats.caption_en: Of course I can. I've lived plenty. Now tighten that bolt.

beats.scene: Years pass in fast cuts: the tower rises floor by floor, both men greyer, their hourglasses nearly empty; at sunset they sit in a rowboat below a stunning finished glass hotel: "بص إحنا عملنا إيه."
beats.speaker: AM SAYED
beats.caption_en: Look at what we built.

beats.scene: Zain leans back in the rowboat, exhausted and proud: "قلتلك. في عشر سنين بالظبط."
beats.speaker: ZAIN
beats.caption_en: I told you. Ten years exactly.

beats.scene: Am Sayed taps his almost-empty hourglass and smiles weakly: "بس ياريت الباشا يفتكر الجايزة."
beats.speaker: AM SAYED
beats.caption_en: I just hope the Basha remembers the reward.

parts.caption:
عقد الرملة — الجزء ٣ (الأخير)
⏳ الباشا وصل... وأول سؤال سأله صدمنا. النهاية!

Made with AI

beats.scene: El-Basha's white convertible speeds along a cliff road; Antar grips the dashboard, looking green and seasick: "يا باشا، أنا دايخ من غير ما نركب بحر أصلاً."
beats.speaker: ANTAR
beats.caption_en: Boss, I'm seasick and we're not even on the sea.

beats.scene: The car stops; El-Basha lowers his sunglasses, sees the glowing glass hotel rising out of the waves, and gasps: "يا نهار أبيض!"
beats.speaker: EL-BASHA
beats.caption_en: Oh my goodness!

beats.scene: On the hotel's marble lobby floor, El-Basha spins around in awe, then frowns at the lobby: "حلو... بس فين الأسانسير؟"
beats.speaker: EL-BASHA
beats.caption_en: Beautiful... but where's the elevator?

beats.scene: Zain and Am Sayed look at each other, then point up at a hundred floors of spiral stairs: "كان فاضلنا يوم واحد يا باشا."
beats.speaker: ZAIN
beats.caption_en: We had one day left, Basha.

beats.scene: Antar tries the first stair, wobbles, and sits down dramatically: "أنا هستنى هنا. بلغوني لما توصلوا."
beats.speaker: ANTAR
beats.caption_en: I'll wait down here. Let me know when you get there.

beats.scene: El-Basha looks at their two nearly empty hourglasses and his own overflowing one; he goes quiet, then smiles: "انتوا الاتنين بنيتوا اللي أنا ما قدرتش أشتريه."
beats.speaker: EL-BASHA
beats.caption_en: You two built what I couldn't buy.

beats.scene: El-Basha tilts his own hourglass and pours golden sand into both of theirs until they overflow: "ودي مش جايزة. ده حقكم."
beats.speaker: EL-BASHA
beats.caption_en: This isn't a reward. It's what you're owed.

beats.scene: Am Sayed hugs Zain as their hourglasses glow full; El-Basha picks up his cane and starts climbing the stairs: "ياللا يا باشا. أول دور بس صعب."
beats.speaker: AM SAYED
beats.caption_en: Come on, Basha. Only the first floor is hard.

series.title: The Return
series.cast: Vertical 9:16 stylized 3D animated cinematic drama, dramatic lighting and moving camera, expressive semi-realistic cartoon humans; every character's mouth visibly moves in sync when they speak and they react to each other. Egyptian Arabic dialogue spoken by the characters themselves, no narrator, no on-screen text or subtitles, no real actor likeness, original designs, no violence shown. Characters (keep identical): ADHAM, a kind wealthy Cairo merchant in his 40s, neat moustache, cream suit (later: long grey beard in prison clothes; later still: elegant disguise with dark glasses and a black suit); LAILA, his daughter (a girl of 8 in Part 1, later a young woman of 24 in a green office blouse); SHAWKY, a smooth-talking partner with slick hair and a gold ring; RAFAAT, a nervous greedy accountant with thick glasses; MOKHTAR, a cold powerful businessman with grey temples and a cane; AM HASSAN, a wise old prisoner with a white beard.

parts.caption:
The Return — Part 1
⚖️ A revenge story in Egyptian Arabic. Follow for Part 2!

Made with AI

beats.scene: A glamorous party in a Cairo villa; Adham raises a glass with his partners: "الليلة دي لشراكتنا يا جماعة!"
beats.speaker: ADHAM
beats.caption_en: Tonight is for our partnership, friends!

beats.scene: Shawky smiles and whispers to Rafaat behind Adham's back: "الليلة دي آخر ليلة ليه."
beats.speaker: SHAWKY
beats.caption_en: Tonight is his last night.

beats.scene: Rafaat nervously slips a folder of fake documents into Adham's desk drawer: "الورق جاهز يا باشا."
beats.speaker: RAFAAT
beats.caption_en: The papers are ready, sir.

beats.scene: Police burst into the party; an officer holds up the folder: "أدهم! إنت مقبوض عليك بتهمة الاختلاس!"
beats.speaker: OFFICER
beats.caption_en: Adham! You're under arrest for embezzlement!

beats.scene: Adham, shocked, turns to his partners: "شوقي! رأفت! قولولهم الحقيقة!"
beats.speaker: ADHAM
beats.caption_en: Shawky! Rafaat! Tell them the truth!

beats.scene: Mokhtar steps forward coldly, leaning on his cane: "الحقيقة إن الورق ما بيكدبش يا أدهم."
beats.speaker: MOKHTAR
beats.caption_en: The truth is, papers don't lie, Adham.

beats.scene: Little Laila runs crying toward her father as he is led away: "بابا! ماتسيبنيش!"
beats.speaker: LAILA
beats.caption_en: Daddy! Don't leave me!

beats.caption_en: I wish I could fly like them… just once.

beats.scene: Deek laughs loudly, puffing his feathers: "فرخة بتطير؟ ده أنا الديك وما بطيرش!"
beats.speaker: DEEK
beats.caption_en: A flying hen? I'm the rooster and I don't fly!

beats.scene: Hamama lands on the coop, lowering her sunglasses: "مين اللي عايزة تطير؟"
beats.speaker: HAMAMA
beats.caption_en: Who wants to fly?

beats.scene: Farkha jumps up excitedly: "أنا! علميني يا حمامة! أرجوكي!"
beats.speaker: FARKHA
beats.caption_en: Me! Teach me, Hamama! Please!

beats.scene: Hamama looks her up and down: "إنتي... تقيلة شوية. بس ماشي. أول درس بكرة الفجر."
beats.speaker: HAMAMA
beats.caption_en: You're… a bit heavy. But fine. First lesson tomorrow at dawn.

beats.scene: Om Samir comes up the stairs shaking the feed bucket: "يا فراخ! العشا!"
beats.speaker: OM SAMIR
beats.caption_en: Chickens! Dinner!

beats.scene: Farkha turns away from the feed: "لأ... أنا عاملة رجيم. عشان الطيران."
beats.speaker: FARKHA
beats.caption_en: No… I'm on a diet. For flying.

beats.scene: Deek and the other hens gasp in shock; Deek faints dramatically: "فرخة مش بتاكل؟! الدنيا اتقلبت!"
beats.speaker: DEEK
beats.caption_en: A hen that won't eat?! The world is upside down!

beats.scene: Dawn; Hamama stands on the edge of the rooftop wall: "الدرس الأول... افردي جناحاتك."
beats.speaker: HAMAMA
beats.caption_en: Lesson one… spread your wings.

beats.scene: Farkha spreads her wings proudly, then flaps as hard as she can; she lifts one centimetre and drops: "طرت؟ طرت؟!"
beats.speaker: FARKHA
beats.caption_en: Did I fly? Did I fly?!

beats.scene: Hamama sighs: "إنتي نطيتي يا حبيبتي."
beats.speaker: HAMAMA
beats.caption_en: You jumped, sweetie.

beats.scene: Deek watches from the coop, singing loudly to distract: "كوكوكوووو! مفيش فايدة!"
beats.speaker: DEEK
beats.caption_en: Cock-a-doodle-doo! It's hopeless!

beats.scene: Farkha tries again from a satellite dish, flapping wildly, and crash-lands in the laundry: "آآآه!"
beats.speaker: FARKHA
beats.caption_en: Aaah!

beats.scene: Om Samir finds Farkha wrapped in a bedsheet like a ghost: "يا خبر! الفرخة لابسة الملاية!"
beats.speaker: OM SAMIR
beats.caption_en: Oh my! The hen is wearing the bedsheet!

beats.scene: Farkha peeks out of the sheet with a new idea sparkling in her eyes: "ملاية... كبيرة... ريح..."
beats.speaker: FARKHA
beats.caption_en: A sheet… big… wind…

beats.scene: Hamama slowly lowers her sunglasses, understanding: "لأ... إنتي ناوية على إيه؟"
beats.speaker: HAMAMA
beats.caption_en: No… what are you planning?

parts.caption:
The Flying Hen — Part 3
🐔 A rooftop hen who dreams of flying — Egyptian Arabic comedy. Follow for Part 4!

Made with AI

beats.scene: Farkha and Hamama secretly tie the bedsheet to a basket like a parachute: "الملاية دي هتطيرني!"
beats.speaker: FARKHA
beats.caption_en: This sheet will make me fly!

beats.scene: Deek sees them and gasps: "إنتي مجنونة! ده الدور العاشر!"
beats.speaker: DEEK
beats.caption_en: You're crazy! This is the tenth floor!

beats.scene: A strong wind gust fills the sheet; the basket lifts off with Farkha inside: "أنا طاايرة!"
beats.speaker: FARKHA
beats.caption_en: I'm flyyying!

beats.scene: Farkha floats over the Cairo rooftops, amazed as pigeons fly beside her: "الدنيا حلوة أوي من فوق!"
beats.speaker: FARKHA
beats.caption_en: The world is so beautiful from up here!

beats.scene: The wind grows stronger and blows her far away; Farkha's smile disappears: "استنى... أنا رايحة فين؟"
beats.speaker: FARKHA
beats.caption_en: Wait… where am I going?

beats.scene: On the roof Deek panics, flapping in circles: "فرخة! ارجعي! إنتي أحلى فرخة في السطح!"
beats.speaker: DEEK
beats.caption_en: Farkha! Come back! You're the prettiest hen on the roof!

beats.scene: Hamama takes off her sunglasses seriously: "لازم نلحقها."
beats.speaker: HAMAMA
beats.caption_en: We have to catch her.

beats.scene: Deek looks at his wings, then at the sky, terrified: "أنا... ما بطيرش." Hamama: "النهارده هتطير."
beats.speaker: DEEK
beats.caption_en: I… don't fly.

parts.caption:

🐔 A rooftop hen who dreams of flying — Egyptian Arabic comedy. THE END. Follow for the next series!

beats.scene: Deek stands on the rooftop edge, shaking: "عشانها... هعملها!" He jumps and flaps with all his heart.
beats.speaker: DEEK
beats.caption_en: For her… I'll do it!

beats.scene: Deek actually glides, wobbling through the air next to Hamama: "أنا بطير! أنا بطيييير!"
beats.speaker: DEEK
beats.caption_en: I'm flying! I'm flyyying!

beats.scene: They reach Farkha's basket as the sheet tears; Farkha screams: "الملاية بتتقطع!"
beats.speaker: FARKHA
beats.caption_en: The sheet is tearing!

beats.scene: Deek grabs the basket with his feet while Hamama pulls the rope: "امسكي فيا!"
beats.speaker: DEEK
beats.caption_en: Hold on to me!

beats.scene: They glide down together and land softly back on the roof in a pile of feathers; Om Samir runs up: "يا ولاد! كنتوا فين؟!"
beats.speaker: OM SAMIR
beats.caption_en: Kids! Where were you?!

beats.scene: Farkha looks at Deek, touched: "إنت طرت... عشاني؟"
beats.speaker: FARKHA
beats.caption_en: You flew… for me?

beats.scene: Deek fluffs his feathers, embarrassed: "كنت بتمرن بس... بس أه. عشانك."
beats.speaker: DEEK
beats.caption_en: I was just practising… but yes. For you.

beats.scene: At sunset the three sit on the rooftop wall looking at Cairo; Farkha smiles: "مش مهم أطير... المهم مين جنبي." Hamama laughs: "وبكرة درس تاني!"
beats.speaker: FARKHA
beats.caption_en: Flying doesn't matter… what matters is who's beside me.
